messages.subject: Formatting of uiOutput
parts:
Hi,

I used a function to create a dynamic number of textInputs:

#server.R 

output$textInputs <- renderUI({
    w <- 1:ncol(props)
    uis <- vector("list", length(w))
    for(i in seq(w)) {
     
      uis[[i]] <- textInput(paste("TL", i, sep = ""), paste("Topic ", i, sep = ""),
                           value = as.character(w[i]))
    }
    uis
  })

#ui.R

 uiOutput("textInputs"), 
  

Displaying all the textInputs works flawlessly, however they are (as expected) all listed one after another vertically. This is a problem if a big number of inputs is created as the user has to scroll very long for the last input. What I would like to do is adjust the formatting, so that 2 inputs will appear in a row, which would only require half the scrolling.

Is this possible?

Thanks and Cheers,
Carsten
